notes: All six gate commands run to completion, exit 0, no failures. What shipped: (1) EndOfSpeechPacket carries optional endpointingOwner (provider_stt|smart_turn|timer|text) + endpointingReason (end_of_speech|force_finalized|typed), populated at the coordinator (owner from session config, reason from the force-finalize flag), at handleUserText (owner=text/reason=typed), and at the remaining genuine emitters so each owner is labelled at its source — stt-core engine (provider_stt), the Smart Turn eos-plugin (smart_turn), and the realtime bridge (timer). Force-finalize is broadcast as a stt.force_finalized bus metric by the watchdog and the shared metrics builder overrides the reason to force_finalized regardless of which emitter produced the completing eos. (2) The decision rides the existing metrics message via the shared turn-metrics builder, so the Node path (index.ts) and the Workers/DO edge path (edge.ts) both emit it through one builder. (3) SessionRecord surfaces endpointingOwner/Reason on TurnRecord (folded out of timings). (4) The timeline renders a plain-language marker naming the owner+reason; a typed turn shows the typed note and never an endpoint marker; an omitted owner renders an explicit 'unknown' marker rather than guessing. Tests cover provider_stt, smart_turn, force-finalized, typed (no endpointer claimed), and unknown at the coordinator, metrics builder/tracker, session-record, turn-timeline, and Timeline UI layers. What I could NOT verify: no live end-to-end run against a real STT/realtime provider — the gate is unit/integration tests, typecheck, and build, not a live session, so the producer labelling for provider_stt/smart_turn/timer is proven per-layer and by typecheck, not by a single live wire capture.
